scope: Archive-first static source parsing, exact named hashes and finite input/index-domain counts only. No project execution or mathematical coefficient/polynomial/gap computation.

generic.qualification: No RNG run or seed coefficients generated. Only width,n,k sufficient-region domains counted. Zero/non-LC counts retained as recorded.

moment.qualification: All-index adapter remains unformalized. Counts indexdomains only; all q, moments, coefficients, reconstruction and gap identities remain saved experiment claims. Negative starts-2,-1 retained.

probe.qualification: Saved symbolic term records only; no polynomial expansion or substitution rerun; negative terms alone are not a source counterexample.

limits: Numerical zero/failure/non-LC outcomes are recorded only.
Source rawmodel truncation inherited and dictionaryequalities finite only.
Actual witness expansion is the saved Lean theorem, not inferred from finite samples.
